The Growth team owns the notifier now. Copy changes are signed off in #growth-eng, and any Growth engineer can approve. This comes from the project memory, which dates it to 2026-09-01. The repo has no CODEOWNERS file or other approval rule that says the same.

An older memory said Dana Okafor had to sign off. She moved to Platform, so that no longer applies. I marked the old memory as challenged and superseded by the newer one.

For the change itself:
- **Plain-text twin:** the receipt template is in `services/notifier/templates/` as `<event>.mjml`. Update the matching `<event>.txt` too, because some corporate mail gateways strip HTML.
- **Variables:** keep the template variables the same, and in snake_case.
